I've confirmed the structure: markdown.Service is the sole interface with one implementation (*service), while MarkdownRenderer is just an internal concrete struct. Tracing the holders, I see APIV1Service and RSSService keep it as a field, and memopayload.Runner has it as a field too, though NewRunner isn't called in production—instead RebuildMemoPayload receives the interface directly as a parameter from memo_service.go. I'll structure my answer as "impl — construction — holders" to keep it focused.
